bot.name: PurpleWave
bot.description: An all-race opponent by Dan Gant with a broad strategy repertoire, precise unit control, and persistent opponent history.

formats.notes: Experimental local play with assigned Protoss, Terran or Zerg. Reviewed gameplay used a compatible ShieldBattery client; broader map, command and rollout coverage remains unverified. See https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/purplewave-sb-6/docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md.

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the BWAPI bridge.

learning.notes: Opponent history, placement caches, and logs stay in the isolated profile. Reset read and write to the empty baseline to clear learning; compatible history is preserved across updates.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Modified ShieldBattery build. Package includes upstream attribution, modification notices, source, and dependency licenses.

localDistribution.evidence: Scoped source, fixed configuration, and distribution review for experimental local play. Final archive validation is recorded separately. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/purplewave-sb-6/docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Separate from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Experimental local 1v1 with assigned Protoss, Terran or Zerg only. Random, teams, FFA, unusual maps and exhaustive late-game command coverage remain unverified.
Requires reviewed gathered-resource reporting, training cancellation, building-flight/Spider Mines commands and supervised release practice in the ShieldBattery client.

Historical release-DLL gameplay and saved-state checks apply to their recorded client/runtime combination. Production approval is deferred until client rollout and signed staging delivery are verified.
Scoped source/runtime review is not an OS sandbox. Human difficulty and public competition remain unreviewed.

sourceReview.evidence: Pinned source and runtime effects reviewed for scoped experimental local play. Final archive validation and historical runtime evidence are recorded at https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/purplewave-sb-6/docs/releases/purplewave-sb-6-admission.md
